v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Dixérunt discípuli * ad beátum Martínum: Cur nos, pater, déseris, aut cui nos desolátos relínquis? Invádent enim gregem tuum lupi rapáces.
text.en: His disciples said * unto Blessed Martin: Father, why wilt thou go away from us? or with whom wilt thou leave us orphans? For ravening wolves will break in upon thy flock.

text.la: Dómine, * si adhuc pópulo tuo sum necessárius, non recúso labórem: fiat volúntas tua.
text.en: Lord, if I be still needful to thy people, I refuse not * to work. thy will be done.

text.la: O virum ineffábilem, * nec labóre victum, nec morte vincéndum, qui nec mori tímuit, nec vívere recusávit!
text.en: Not to be told is this man's glory; * whom work did not and death could not conquer; who neither feared to die, nor refused to live.

text.la: Oculis ac mánibus * in cælum semper inténtus, invíctum ab oratióne spíritum non relaxábat, allelúia.
text.en: With eyes and hands lifted up to heaven, * he never let his mighty spirit slacken in prayer. Alleluia.

text.la: Martínus * Ábrahæ sinu lætus excípitur: Martínus, hic pauper et módicus, cælum dives ingréditur, hymnis cæléstibus honorátur.
text.en: Martin is called joyfully into Abraham's bosom. * Martin, who was poor here and of small estimation, entereth rich into heaven, and the songs of heaven are raised in his honour.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: O beátum virum, * cuius ánima paradísum póssidet! Unde exsúltant Ángeli, lætántur Archángeli, chorus Sanctórum proclámat, turba Vírginum invítat: Mane nobíscum in ætérnum.
text.en: O how blessed a man is he! * His soul hath entered into possession in Paradise. There the Angels cry aloud for joy, there the Archangels make glad, there the whole company of the Saints do shout, there the army of the Virgins do call others to follow, (saying:) Make thine everlasting abode with us.

text.la: Deus, qui cónspicis, quia ex nulla nostra virtúte subsístimus: concéde propítius; ut, intercessióne beáti Martíni Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, contra ómnia advérsa muniámur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that the worshipful Feast of thy blessed Confessor and Bishop Martin, may avail us to the increase both of godliness toward thee, and healthfulness to our own souls.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beáti Mennæ Mártyris tui natalítia cólimus, intercessióne eius in tui nóminis amóre roborémur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that we who celebrate the martyrdom of blessed Menna, through his intercession be strengthened in your love.
